_comment: User-maintained agent lockout / rate-limit schedule. The dashboard reads this (GET /api/limits) and renders a 'next reset' countdown panel. Edit the fields below to match reality. Times are ISO-8601 UTC (trailing Z). reset_interval_hours drives the rolling countdown from last_reset; for fixed daily windows leave reset_interval_hours null and set next_reset explicitly.
